design_detail: Design of exit tax system in China to combat tax avoidance and regulate high-net-worth migration
quote_original: 退籍税制度是为应对纳税人移居移民造成税收流失而设立的税收制度。伴随经济全球化浪潮,各国退籍税制度经历了一系列发展变化,对打击逃避税、规范非正常移居移民行为起到了积极作用。本文阐述了退籍税制度的基本问题,分析了其国际实践历程及成因,以供进一步深化研究及制定政策参考。
quote_en: The exit tax system is a tax system established to deal with tax revenue loss caused by taxpayer migration. With the wave of economic globalization, various national exit tax systems have undergone developments and played an active role in combating tax evasion and regulating abnormal migration behaviors. This article elaborates on the basic issues of the exit tax system and analyzes its international practice to provide reference for policy formulation.

design_detail: Immediate establishment of exit tax system in China under Common Prosperity and Marxist tax theory
quote_original: 西方国家陆续征收退出税,有其必然性和重要性,值得我国借鉴。我们应当以马克思主义税收理论为基础,依据我国现阶段的国情和民意,尽快设立退出税制。本文首先阐述世界各国的退出税,然后阐述马克思税收理论与退出税的关系,最后着重分析我国设立退出税的价值考量和可行性,强调这是贯彻以人民为中心的发展思想的重要措施,符合共富共享的目标和广泛的民意基础。
quote_en: Western countries progressively levying exit taxes has its necessity and importance, and is worthy of reference for our country. We should base ourselves on Marxist taxation theory, adhere to China's current national conditions and public will, and establish an exit tax system as soon as possible. This article analyzes the value considerations and feasibility of establishing an exit tax in China, emphasizing that it is an important measure to implement people-centered development and accords with common prosperity goals.

design_detail: Exit tax regime to defend tax sovereignty, advance horizontal equity, and promote common prosperity
quote_original: 弃籍税是对“弃籍者”征税。OECD大多数成员国和部分发展中国家已开征弃籍税。征收弃籍税，有利于维护国家税收主权、实现横向公平、推进共同富裕。借鉴弃籍税的国际实践，结合我国现行的税法体系，我国应完善个人所得税中弃籍环节的税制设计，并建立完善财产申报登记与评估、税源信息共享、避免国际双重征税等配套征管机制。
quote_en: An exit tax is a tax levied on expatriates. Most OECD member states and some developing countries have instituted exit taxes. Drawing upon international practice and China's tax system, China should optimize the tax design of exit provisions in individual income tax and establish supporting mechanisms.
